title: Sunstone Project
description: Partnering with Sunstone to develop a reusable AI-powered workflow that transforms large collections of documents into concise, one-page executive summaries. Using prompt and context engineering, the project focuses on producing accurate, consistent reports while streamlining document analysis for non-technical users.

title: Ensure Agency Project
description: Developing an iOS-based home scanning solution that uses computer vision and machine learning to capture accurate property measurements and estimate home reconstruction costs. The project aims to help California homeowners avoid underinsurance by replacing outdated public-record estimates with real-world property data.
